'''Bludlow''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. He sat with the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Dratun]] and refused to leave in the wake of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] curfew, despite the appeals of [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ludlo-poster.jpg|thumb|left|150px|"Ludlo" wanted poster from a 1978 publicity campaign]]
Although ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''{{'s}} script identifies him as Bludlow, he is often mistakenly referred to as '''Ludlow''' or '''Ludlo'''.

In a [[1978]] [[Lucasfilm]] publicity campaign, actors dressed as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] put up wanted posters at department stores, shopping centers, and public events to promote Fett's image as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. One of these posters referred to a Rodian named "Ludlo, brother of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], last seen at the cantina in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']]."<ref name="Proto-Fett">{{SWArchive|url=episode-v/bts/article/f20061019/index.html?page=3|text=Proto-Fett: The Birth of Boba - Pre-''Empire'' Publicity}}</ref> Ludlo and Bludlow where confirmed to be the same in an Lucasfilm.com article.<ref name="Boba Fett Poster">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/history-in-objects-boba-fett-wanted-poster|text=History in Objects: Boba Fett "Wanted" Poster}}</ref>
